limits: GPU_BUSY prechecks wait at most 15 minutes per check and 30 minutes in total; original idle thresholds remain unchanged.
V2 starts a fresh 234-case run; V1 stopped run and its 16 passing cases are preserved separately.
E02a expands adapter differential/contract tests only; full E02 is not complete.
PQMagic SHAKE is the sole CPU oracle; PQClean independent oracle and official KATs are NOT_RUN.
KeyGen and Sign use three new deterministic seeds; these are not security randomness claims.
Verify CLI has no seed argument; different B values use prefixes of its fixed generated corpus.
KeyGen/Verify exercise supported tail batches; Sign only supports selected multiples of 256 here.
Sign message sizes are 0 and 32 bytes with empty context; full length/context/prehash coverage is NOT_RUN.
Compute Sanitizer, formal-capture boundary drivers and sampler exhaustion remain separate tasks.
D3 raw-donor placeholders and internal canaries remain excluded/skipped as in the pinned adapter.
No compilation, public Engine qualification or performance comparison is performed.
All adapter timing is diagnostic only and must not be plotted as formal performance.
Reused SM120 V3 modules use --Ofast-compile=min for the three ML-DSA-87 operations only.
